hero.lead: Founded in 2009, RGT Global has grown from a four-person consultancy into a distributed engineering partner with delivery centres on three continents.
hero.title: We are engineers who have run the systems we advise on

offices.heading: Where we are
offices.lead: Three delivery centres, one engineering culture.

story.heading: Our story
story.p1: RGT Global began when four platform engineers left a large systems integrator, convinced that most enterprise software problems were organisational rather than technical. That conviction still shapes how we work: we embed with your teams rather than delivering over a wall.
story.p2: Today we employ 1,180 engineers across delivery centres in Hyderabad, Berlin and Toronto. Roughly two-thirds of our work is multi-year platform engagements; the remainder is short-run modernisation and assessment work.
story.p3: We are deliberately not a body shop. Every engagement is staffed by a standing team with a named technical lead, and we decline work we do not believe we can deliver well.

values.heading: How we work
values.oneBody: Continuity beats headcount. Our median engagement runs 26 months with the same core team.
values.threeBody: Success is your team operating the platform without us. We plan the handover from the first week.
values.twoBody: Decisions are recorded with their reasoning, so the next engineer inherits the argument and not just the outcome.
